title: The Completion of Material Forms
pinyin: Gǔ shén bù sǐ， shì wèi xuán pìn。
Xuán pìn zhī mén， shì wèi tiān dì gēn。
Mián mián ruò cún， yòng zhī bù qín。
english: The valley spirit dies not, aye the same; The female mystery thus do we name. Its gate, from which at first they issued forth, Is called the root from which grew heaven and earth. Long and unbroken does its power remain, Used gently, and without the touch of pain.
